items.title: Generate Images from Dish Names
items.description: Type your dish name — 'Grilled Salmon with Lemon', 'Margherita Pizza', 'Chocolate Lava Cake' — and AI generates a professional food photo. Choose from multiple styles and backgrounds.

items.title: Optimized for Fast Loading
items.description: Every generated image is automatically compressed and converted to modern formats. Your menu stays lightning-fast on any device, even with photos on every dish.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get professional food photos for your menu in four simple steps.

steps.title: Open Any Menu Item
steps.description: Navigate to the item you want a photo for in your dashboard. You can generate images for new dishes or replace existing photos on any menu item.

steps.title: Click Generate Image
steps.description: AI creates a professional food photo based on the dish name and description. The more detail you provide in the description, the more accurate the result.

steps.title: Review the Result
steps.description: Preview the generated image before applying it. If you'd like a different look, regenerate to get a new variation. Each generation produces a unique image.

steps.title: Use in Your Menu
steps.description: The image is automatically optimized, compressed to WebP format, and appears on your live menu immediately. Guests see professional food photos on every dish.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI menu images.

items.question: How do I generate a food photo?
items.answer: Open any menu item in your dashboard, tap 'Generate Image', and AI creates a professional food photo based on the dish name and description. Pick the one you like.

items.question: Can I use my own photos instead?
items.answer: Absolutely. Upload your own photos from your phone or computer. AI generation is optional — use it when you don't have a photo ready.

items.question: How many images can I generate?
items.answer: Image generation limits depend on your plan. Growth includes a monthly allowance, and Pro offers a higher limit. You can always upload your own photos without limits.

items.question: Are generated images unique to my restaurant?
items.answer: Yes. Each image is generated uniquely for your specific dish. No stock photos — every image is created fresh based on your menu item.

items.question: What image formats are supported for upload?
items.answer: Upload JPG, PNG, or WebP images up to 10MB. All uploaded images are automatically compressed and converted to WebP for optimal loading speed on any device.

items.question: Can I generate images for all items at once?
items.answer: Images are generated per item to ensure the best quality for each dish. Open any item, click generate, and the photo is ready in seconds.

items.question: Do AI-generated images look realistic?
items.answer: Yes. The AI produces high-quality, realistic food photography. Results are best when the dish name and description are detailed — for example, 'Grilled salmon fillet with lemon butter sauce and asparagus' produces a more accurate image than just 'salmon'.
